newsitem.title: USA: Learning Tree sees costs continuing in Q4.
newsitem.headline: Learning Tree sees costs continuing in Q4.

text.p: Learning Tree International Inc said the development expenses that dampened its third quarter earnings will continue in the fourth quarter.
After the market closed on Thursday, Learning Tree posted third quarter earnings of $0.14 a share compared to $0.17 a share despite a 58 percent increase in revenues.
Learning Tree said its third quarter earnings were hurt by the investment in the launch of the company's two new business lines, Power Seminars and Learning Solutions.
Learning Tree, which provides education and training for corporate information technology professionals working in business and government organizations, lost 6-1/8 to 28-5/8 in Nasdaq trading.

"As expected, our income during the quarter was impacted by the formation of two new divisions. Our new Power Seminars division presents multi-day conferences....(and) we invested heavily in developing and marketing the seminars, and in building a dedicated telemarketing team for this product line," Learning Tree said.
"We expect to continue investing in these areas during the fourth quarter," the company said.
Learning Tree also said it has been investing in the expansion of its information systems and general infrastructure.
